question: At which copying fidelity does a population lose its fittest genotype?
name: master sequence under mutation (quasispecies, single-peak landscape)

carrier.name: frequency x of the master sequence; negative x lies outside the physical range and is kept so that the exchange of stability at x = 0 can be followed

closure: single-peak fitness landscape and constant population; mutants do not mutate back to the master sequence
observable: the frequency of the master sequence
assumptions: master fitness f0 and mutant fitness 1
copying fidelity q of the whole genome
the value f0 = 2 and the noise intensity are chosen for the example
